app.name: ExcelAIt
app.tagline: Find what you are good at, learn it, prove it, and claim what you are owed.

student.name: Student
student.desc: Class 9 to graduation, ITI, or looking for work

facilitator.name: Teacher / Career Mitra
facilitator.desc: I guide a class or a group of students

partner.name: Partner organisation
partner.desc: College, ITI, NGO, employer or CSR

common.comingTitle: This part is on its way
common.comingBody: {{section}} arrives in phase {{phase}} of the build. Everything here will work offline once it is ready.

auth.welcomeTitle: Your guide from learning to earning
auth.welcomeBody: Careers you never heard of, a plan to get there, and the scholarships you qualify for. In your language.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it on this phone to finish creating your account.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up yet. Add the Supabase keys to frontend/.env.

home.studentLead: Let's find what you are good at. Start with a few questions; you can speak or tap.
home.nextCareers: Answer a few questions and see careers that fit you, with reasons.
home.nextMoney: See which scholarships and schemes you qualify for.
home.nextLearn: Get a plan for what to learn next, and lessons from your own books.
home.roleLead: Your {{role}} workspace is ready. Its tools arrive phase by phase.
home.pendingSync_one: 1 change saved on this phone. It will sync when you are online.
home.pendingSync_other: {{count}} changes saved on this phone. They will sync when you are online.

state.q: Which state do you live in?

family_income_annual.q: About how much does your family earn in a year?
family_income_annual.hint: All family income together. A rough answer is fine; you can change it later.

social_category.hint: Only if you are comfortable. Many scholarships depend on it.

marks_percent.q: What percentage did you get in your last exam?

gender.q: Are you a girl or a boy?
gender.hint: Some schemes are only for girls.

school_type.q: What kind of school do you go to?

is_minority.q: Do you belong to a minority community?
is_minority.hint: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain or Parsi.

is_disabled.q: Do you have a certified disability of 40% or more?

institution_aicte.q: Is your college approved by AICTE?
institution_aicte.hint: Most engineering, pharmacy and management colleges are. Ask your college office if unsure.

in_full_time_job.q: Do you have a full-time job right now?

is_orphan_or_covid_affected.q: Have you lost a parent, or are you a ward of a martyred armed forces member?

in_top_class_school.q: Is your school on the government's 'Top Class School' list?
in_top_class_school.hint: Your school office can tell you.

above_80_percentile_class12.q: Were you in the top 20% of your Class 12 board results?

family_govt_employee.q: Does anyone in your family have a government job?

cap_admission.q: Did you get admission through the CAP (centralised) process?

needs_income_soon.q: Do you need to start earning soon?
needs_income_soon.hint: For example, to help your family in the next year or two.

can_relocate.q: Could you move to a city for study or work?

start.title: About you
start.subtitle: A few quick questions. Tap an answer, or talk to the guide.

subjects.q: Which subjects do you like most?

guide.opening: Namaste! Tell me a little about yourself. Which class are you in, and what do you like doing?
guide.saved: Got it, I have noted that.
guide.offline: The guide needs internet. You can still answer by tapping.
guide.notHeard: I could not hear that clearly. Please try again or type.
guide.noMic: The microphone is not available. Please allow it, or type instead.

careers.emptyBody: Answer a few questions about what you enjoy and where you study. It takes two minutes.
careers.subtitle: Matched to what you enjoy, your subjects and work near you. Every match shows why.
careers.whatIfCity: I can move to a city

reasons.local_demand: Many jobs near villages and small towns
reasons.marks: Your marks meet the usual {{n}}% bar

gaps.needs_city: Mostly in cities, and you said you cannot move
gaps.marks: Most courses ask for about {{n}}% marks
gaps.cost: Training costs more, but scholarships can help

money.emptyBody: Answer a few questions and we check every scholarship and scheme for you, right on your phone.
money.subtitle: Checked by fixed government rules, not guessed. Answer one question to unlock more.
money.kpiRupeesHint: From schemes with a fixed amount

verdict.needs_info: We need a little more to check
verdict.not_eligible: You do not qualify right now

money.disclaimer: The final decision is made by the government office. Always check the official page before applying.
